title: RAG Evaluation: Metrics, Tools, and the Context Gap (2026)
snippet: RAG systems are evaluated across two dimensions: retrieval quality and generation quality. A standard framework uses four core metrics, each targeting a distinct failure mode, and is implemented by tools like RAGAS, TruLens, and DeepEval.
